Done. NEONSTRIKE shipped, archived, playtested.

**What built:** `archives/neonstrike/` — CS-style FPS, fully ray-traced. No triangles. WebGL2 fragment shader casts real rays per pixel: primary vs analytic scene (level AABBs + bot spheres via RGBA32F data texture), shadow rays to moon, AO rays, up to 3 reflection bounces. ACES tonemap, fog, procedural night sky with stars.

**Game:** three-lane map (mid / long A / long B, two sites, crates, neon strips = actual emissive lights). Buy phase → live → end rounds, first to 8. Economy: $800 start, +$300 kill, +$3250 win. 7 weapons incl. scoped sniper + kevlar. Bots: waypoint pathfinding, view-cone + ray-traced LOS spotting, reaction delay, strafe-and-fire combat, 4 difficulties. HUD: radar, killfeed, damage numbers, hitmarkers, viewmodel, tracers, scope overlay.

**Configs:** 37 settings, 5 tabs — resolution scale, RT bounces, shadow mode/samples, AO quality, fog, frame cap, full crosshair editor with live preview, sensitivity/invert/crouch-toggle, bot count/difficulty/round time. Presets potato→ultra. All persist to localStorage.

**Textures/SFX:** all procedural — triplanar GLSL brick/planks/brushed metal/hazard chevrons; 21 sounds synthesized from pure DSP (testable as raw arrays), stereo-panned by source direction.

**Playtest:** real game in headless Chrome (SwiftShader WebGL2). **60/60 checks passed** — zero JS errors, 6 vantage screenshots pixel-verified, all 11 material swatches rendered + distinct, all 21 SFX verified (duration/peak/RMS), hitscan kill confirmed (bot 100 → −12 hp, headshot), bots navigated map AND hunted player down during screenshot tour (100→58 hp — unscripted), round win + payouts + rifle purchase verified, bounces 0→3 changed 15.6% of pixels, settings persisted. Report + screenshots: `archives/neonstrike/playtest/`.

Two real bugs found playtesting: test fired through A-connector wall (game correctly blocked ray — fixed test to verify LOS first), and wall-clock waits broke under software-render sim pacing (switched to state-machine waits).

Hub verified: entry on `/api/entries`, game serves 200. `npm start` → Launch App. Software FPS floor: 41 potato / 8 balanced; real GPU runs balanced/ultra fine.
